about: We offer complete automotive repair service in our 10,000 square feet facility conveniently located in Al Quoz. Our philosophies and beliefs send us on a mission to create an atmosphere where a client may have fairly priced high quality automotive repair while receiving both respect and honesty. BT Garage is dedicated to all of your automotive needs.

Balqis Throne Garage established in 1993, is a Dubai based company specializing in the mechanical, air-conditioning & Electrical works to light, medium and heavy vehicles. We aim to provide our clients with the highest possible technologies available in automobile repairing, with highly skilled staff.
